method: Open weights: HF API (sort=trendingScore, and author=<lab> sort=createdAt for 38 lab orgs), filtered to createdAt inside the window; params = safetensors.total (or gguf.total) from the HF API; licence = cardData.license. Runtime check: the GGUF general.architecture must appear in ggml-org/llama.cpp src/llama-arch.cpp (master, read 2026-09-28), and the Ollama manifest (registry protocol on huggingface.co or registry.ollama.ai) must carry a chat template. Frontier API: lab primary pages only (Anthropic newsroom + pricing doc, OpenAI API changelog/model page/pricing doc, Google Gemini API changelog + pricing, DeepSeek API news + pricing, xAI models doc, Mistral changelog). A date shown as HF createdAt is the lab repo creation date, which is the primary record we could read; where a lab blog gives a date it is cited instead. RE-READ 2026-09-28T13:5x-14:0xZ by lane newest-models-20260928 from the build pod: HF API author=<org> sort=createdAt for 62 lab orgs (155 repos in the 30-day window), HF search by name for the Ollama-library newest listing (https://ollama.com/search?o=newest), llama.cpp src/llama-arch.cpp master, Ollama registry manifests + config blobs (renderer/parser/requires), OpenRouter GET /api/v1/models (public, no key) for $0-priced endpoints, and the Gemini API pricing page for the free tier.

kaggle_budget.hardware: 2x Tesla T4, 16 GB each (kernel HALTs on anything else)
kaggle_budget.rule_used: fits = weights+projector <= ~10 GB on one T4 (KV-cache headroom), OR <= 24 GB split over both T4s (Ollama spreads layers across GPUs when one card is too small; the worker sets no num_gpu). Plus: llama.cpp or an Ollama built-in renderer supports it, and a public ungated manifest is pinned. Measured anchors 2026-09-28: qwen2.5:7b (4.7 GB) 1,225 s kernel wall; MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B Q8_0 (10.2 GB) 1,150 s; MiniCPM5-2B Q8_0 (2.7 GB) 453 s. A split (>15 GB) model's kernel wall is UNMEASURED.
kaggle_budget.cap_source: run.sh QUOTA_CAP_H (trailing-7-day kernel wall recorded by the job; Kaggle's own GPU quota is ~30 h/week)

With-reasoning = floor + 1,000 reasoning tokens per item billed as output: an ASSUMPTION for budgeting, not a measurement. The mill instrument has no API transport today: intake requires an ollama:<tag>@<manifest digest> subject, and an API model has no manifest digest to pin, so any API run is a new instrument that needs its own design and owner ruling before its cards could exist. Sending frozen public banks to a vendor API also exposes them to that vendor.
